title: Principal localization algebra equivalence
statement: For every commutative ring R, natural numbers n,c, polynomials f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R and h : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R, the quotient of MvPolynomial (Fin (n+1)) R by the span of the renamed f_i together with rename(h)·X(last n)−1 is R-algebra equivalent to Localization.Away at the quotient image of h; the equivalence sends each old variable to its localization image and the new variable to IsLocalization.Away.invSelf.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00SS (lemma-base-change-relative-global-complete-intersection, line 36640), part (2), proof line 36665 ('the localization at one element can be described as S_g = S[x_{n+1}]/(g x_{n+1} - 1)'); the fibre dimensions, left implicit there, as in the proof of Lemma Tag 00SA (lemma-localize-lci, line 35852: 'By the remarks following the definition dim(S_g) = n - c') with the remark after Definition Tag 00S9 (definition-lci-field, lines 35834-35849); the definition is Tag 00SP (definition-relative-global-complete-intersection, line 36506); tags verified in stacks-project/tags/tags

proof.text: Evaluate the enlarged polynomial ring in the principal localization, sending the old variables to their quotient localization images and the last variable to invSelf(g). Polynomial algebra-hom extensionality identifies the restriction along rename with the quotient map followed by the localization map. Each renamed f_i evaluates to zero and the appended relation evaluates to zero by IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf. Ideal.span_le and Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ therefore give forward : B →ₐ[R] S.

The quotient map to B composed with rename kills every f_i, so Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ gives base : A →ₐ[R] B. The last defining relation gives base(g) times the last variable equal to one, hence base(g) is a unit. Apply IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom to obtain backward : S →ₐ[R] B. Its value on the localization algebra map is base by Away.lift_eq; multiplying by the unit base(g) and cancelling identifies its value on invSelf(g) with the last variable.

Use IsLocalization.algHom_ext, Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext and polynomial extensionality to check forward composed with backward on the old variables. Check backward composed with forward on all polynomial variables, separating castSucc variables from last. The preceding formulas make both composites identities. AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom constructs the equivalence, and aeval_X together with Fin.snoc_castSucc and Fin.snoc_last proves the two required generator formulas.

split_report.summary: Read 00SS (line 36640) and its proof, 00SA (line 35852) with the remark after 00S9, the definition 00SP (line 36506); tags verified in tags/tags. Statement kept. Corrected source.place: the proof of 00SS cites 00P3 (lemma-dimension-preserved-field-extension), not 00P4, and only for part (1), which part (2) does not need. Six steps: (1) T' = T_g via the coefficient-map kernel and R[x]/(rx-1) = R_r leaves (route of the merged 00SA node, step 3); (2) the fibre F = T (x) k(p) is k[x]/(f-bar) (polynomial scalar extension, tensor-quotient base change); (3) T' (x) k(p) = F_g (algebra localization base change leaf); (4) a nonzero fibre of T' lies over a nonzero fibre of T, which is equidimensional of dimension n-c (equidimensional node); (5) dim of the nonzero principal localization is n-c (open immersion of D(e), dimension at a point on an open subspace, supremum of local dimensions); (6) conclusion with (n+1)-(c+1). No new nodes. Mathlib searches of the item (all three kinds, recorded at creation) suffice: no relative global complete intersection notion in Mathlib, not a leaf.

lean.statement: theorem principalLocalization_algEquiv (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n c : ℕ) (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) : ∃ e : (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ ↦ MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) (fun i ↦ MvPolynomial.rename Fin.castSucc (f i)) (MvPolynomial.rename Fin.castSucc h * MvPolynomial.X (Fin.last n) - 1)))) ≃ₐ[R] Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) h), (∀ i : Fin n, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X (Fin.castSucc i))) = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)) (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) h)) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X i))) ∧ e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X (Fin.last n))) = IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) h)
